g.text: Review these current local files. Setup preserves the imported trust files and creates fresh local
trust. If finishing an interrupted setup, use the same passphrase you chose then. Script execution still
This setup uses a local file marker. Protection against restoring an older copy of the entire trust
Ctrl+Shift+F focus | F6 next pane | Shift+F6 previous pane | F1 help | Enter continue setup | Y trace | Ctrl+K switch session | Ctrl+T new tab | Ctrl+P · Ctrl+Q
